hero.headline: Dallas County Addiction Treatment
hero.subhead: Accredited detox, residential and outpatient addiction treatment a short drive east from Dallas County.

sections.heading: Treatment for Dallas County, from our Johnston campus
body: Dallas County is one of the fastest-growing counties in Iowa, and for many residents the nearest accredited detox is still east of the county line. Our Johnston campus is a short drive from Waukee, Adel, Perry and Dallas Center, close enough for family involvement and for a genuine step-down through PHP and IOP rather than a discharge straight home.

We frequently work with Dallas County clients who have tried outpatient counselling alone and relapsed. Starting with medical stabilisation and then moving through levels of care in one place, with one clinical team, is usually what changes the outcome.

sections.heading: Every Level of Care in One Place
sections.subheading: Dallas County clients can move between levels without changing providers.

items.title: Medical Detox
items.text: Medically supervised withdrawal with 24/7 clinical monitoring.

items.title: Residential Inpatient
items.text: Full-time inpatient care in a structured, private setting.

items.title: Partial Hospitalization
items.text: Full-day clinical programming without an overnight stay.

items.title: Intensive Outpatient
items.text: Structured therapy on a schedule that fits work or school.

items.title: Dual Diagnosis Treatment
items.text: Integrated care for addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions.

items.title: Aftercare & Alumni
items.text: Alumni support and relapse-prevention planning after treatment.

sections.heading: Getting here from Dallas County
body: We are at 5820 Winwood Dr, Johnston, IA 50131 — a short drive east from Dallas County, with easy access from I-35, I-80 and I-235. Familiar landmarks nearby include Waukee, Adel, Perry, Van Meter and Dallas Center.

sections.heading: Start treatment near Dallas County today
body: Admissions specialists are available 24/7. Calls are free, confidential, and carry no obligation to enrol.
